scene skycold
Spring is different from how it’s supposed to be here.
Well, I guess it’s not really supposed to be here at all if you really want to get technical about it.
But it is. And sometimes, it’s hotter. Sometimes, it’s colder. There’s never any rhyme or reason, though.
We seldom even check our phones for the weather forecast anymore since there was only a 25%% chance it’d be correct on any given day.
Life at this point is just a sequence of waking up, looking out the window, then opening the front door to try and confirm our suspicions.
I thought I had it right today. The sun was shining, the flowers were basking in its light, and I envisioned a world in which this blazer alone would feel like too much.
And I was right at first. But now I’m wrong.
Now, it’s cold. And while there is no snow to serve as a more physical, tangible reminder of this, there’s still the creeping nostalgia and silence that always comes falling to earth alongside it.
scene yumibridgecold1
That silence is quickly broken by ska music, though.
: Wow. I can’t even remember the last time I heard this song.
: And I can’t remember the last time you said anything that made any amount of sense.
: You look really pretty today, Yumi.
: Die.
: How glad I am that some things never change.
scene yumibridgecold2
: The fuck are you even doing here? We stopped runnin’ into each other like this fucking years ago, didn’t we?
: Yeah. Because now we have each other’s phone numbers and can hang out whenever we want.
: Soooo...never?
: Never. Every day. Same difference.
scene yumibridgecold3
: I repeat — die.
: We’ve come a long way, haven’t we?
scene yumibridgecold4
: Hm?
: Just that you only hate me out of habit, now. We’ve been through too much together for any of that to be authentic at this point.
: I have plenty of reasons to hate you still. I barely even have a best friend anymore now that she thinks I’m fucking you.
: Actually, current Chika would allow you to fuck me so long as it's under the pretense that we love one another.
: Yeah. Which brings me back to the whole “I barely even have a best friend anymore” shit because your fucking creepy relationship with her somehow rotted her brain and turned her into a sex zombie.
: Oh, I see what you mean now.
scene yumibridgecold5
: Guess you’re right about going through a lot together, though. Don’t feel the need to run away anymore, at least.
: Yeah. I imagine knowing the world could end at any moment sort of overtakes me in the threatening department.
: Yeah...
scene yumibridgecold6
: What are you doing here?
: Looking for you, I guess.
: Why? We settin’ up another apocalypse meeting or something?
: No. Just wanted to see you and wishfully thought we might fatefully bump into one another up here again.
scene yumibridgecold7
: Mm. We sure have a lot of fated meetings on top of shit, don’t we?
: Think it means something?
: That we’re...always lookin’ down on everyone else, maybe?
: Oh, cool. I didn’t expect you to actually have an answer. Guess Imani’s been teaching you well if you’ve figured out symbolism now.
: She’s...fine.
: Still...
: Kind of wish it was you, though.
: Uh...did my ears just deceive me? Or did you just-
scene yumibridgecold8
: D-Don’t get the wrong idea! There’s just...more pressure on me now! I ain’t allowed to fuck up as much as I could when you were the teacher!
: What?! Don’t just...stare at me, fuckmonkey! Say something!
: I’m glad I met you, Yumi.
scene yumibridgecold9
: What?
: Man, you ain’t gonna fuckin’ try to kill yourself again, are you? Because I got major death flags from that.
: No, nothing like that. It’s just comforting knowing there’s someone else along for the ride who isn’t going to just forget how long it’s been anymore.
scene yumibridgecold10
: We don’t...know that for sure, though...
: Blondie says there’s a chance my shit might get reset again even if I made it through the last...thing.
: There’s a chance for that to happen to any of us.
: Then ain’t it a little dangerous to start talkin’ about how nice it is to have somethin’ that could be taken away at any moment?
: Ain’t that gonna just...make it hurt even more if it actually happens?
: Yeah...I know that better than anyone. At least...now I know that better than anyone. Someone else held that honor until recently.
: Ponytail...right?
scene yumibridgecold11
: So she’s the one you-
: Was the one.
: I don’t know what I want anymore. Or who. Or...even when.
: When?
scene continuingrestart25
scene yumibridgecold11
: I just...feel like there’s more to this sometimes.
: More...how?
: It’s hard to explain. But...
: What if this is only one example of Kumon-mi?
: I ain’t followin’...
: Well, you said yourself that you had memories of things that hadn’t actually happened to you before, right?
: Yeah, but...ain’t that shit just from different timelines or whatever?
: Maybe. But different timelines are essentially different worlds, aren’t they? Like...what if there’s a world out there where you and I are talking up here right now while holding hands?
: Then I’m perfectly fine with stayin’ exactly where or when I am.
: Yumi-
scene yumibridgecold12
: I get what you’re sayin.
: It all just sounds too fuckin’ convenient, though. And it ain’t like we have any way of actually gettin’ to those worlds or...timelines or...whatever the fuck you wanna call ‘em.
: So imaginin’ the possibility of something like that ain’t gonna do shit but make you feel even more helpless than you already are.
: If you could go anywhere...at any time...where would you go?
: Feel like we had a similar talk before...
: Well...I imagine we probably did then. But my memory’s shit even without the interference of time and the divine. So why not just give me current Yumi’s answer?
: Current Yumi...
: Current Yumi would probably stay right here.
: There is no way this is the happiest you can be.
: Yeah. Well current Yumi ain’t about to start fantasizing about worlds where everything goes well for her when she ain’t done shit to deserve it.
: Yumi, you’re not-
: Can you spare me whatever bullshit you’ve got to say about how I’m not that bad just because I ain’t as shitty as I used to be? I’m still a fucking bitch. And you’re still a fucking predator.
: We can’t redeem ourselves for that. We’ve gotta...start over. Build ourselves up from the bottom. But neither of us have it in ourselves to actually do that, so...
: Current Yumi would stay right where she is...and accept whatever punishment time and the divine have in store for her. The other Yumis can benefit from making better choices than her.
: You’ve really grown up, Yumi.
scene yumibridgecold13
: Rad. Maybe you’ll finally leave me alone now.
: Doubtful. I’m bound to fatefully encounter you in higher altitudes for the rest of our lives. It’s just how things work here, I think.
: Well, for what it’s worth...
: I’m glad I met you too.
: Want to pick up where we left off on the beach and actually kiss now?
scene yumibridgecold14
: And risk Chika showin’ up and actually tossing me over a railing this time? Pass.
: We could always go somewhere more pri-
: Don’t.
: Just don’t...okay?
scene yumibridgecold15
: I’ve already conceded that I don’t hate you. Just take that as a win for now and stop pushing me to do more. I’ve got enough going on in my head as-is.
: If I ever want to enable you, I’ll make the first move.
scene yumibridgecold16
: Still ain’t ever gonna happen, though. Not unless time magically throws us into a world where we’re the same age.
: So you’re saying you’d be with me if we were the same age?
scene yumibridgecold17
: I’m saying you’d have a much better shot.
scene yumibridgecold18
: That is all I’m going to say, though...pervert.
scene skycold
: I’ll take it. It’s better than knowing I have no chance at all.
: Yeah. Meanwhile, I’ll continue wanting to throw up in my mouth for just knowing you want one.
: Yeah...my life would be so much easier if everyone else looked at things like you.
: Hah. You think having more of me around would make your life easier? Only reason I haven’t kicked the shit out of you yet’s because you’re bigger than me.
: Nineteen other Yumi’s, though? You’re fucked.
: So many Yumis. It’s like a dream come true.
: A nightmare, more like.
scene black
: Do you have any plans after this?
: After what? Convincing you to fuck off and leave me alone so I can go back to spitting on cars?
: Yeah. I don’t have any plans for tonight. So I was wondering if maybe-
: Pass.
: Tch. One day, you’ll appreciate me for who and what I am.
: Heh. Maybe.
: I’ve already got plans tonight, though. And...lookin’ at the time, I should probably start headin’ over now.
: Heading over where exactly? Should I be worried? Is it a boy?
: It’s my mom, you fucking douchenozzle.
: You’re leaving me for your mom? What kind of soap opera is this?
: You want to come too? Just gonna watch movies and shit.
: You’re actually inviting me?
: So long as you don’t say yes. I have to uninvite you if you agree.
: Why even give me a choice then?
: Sometimes, you’ve gotta give somebody a choice. Even if the answer’s already made up. It’s the only way to make ‘em think they’re really free.
: None of us are free here. No choice will convince me otherwise.
: Yeah, well...we can’t all be as smart as you.
: Later, Sensei. I’ll see you when I see you.
: Probably on another bridge or something...
Yumi turns to leave, but I decide to stay up here for a little while longer.
I don’t plan on spitting on cars or anything like that, though — just passing time while I wait for the world to catch up to how fast I’ve been spinning lately.
scene yumibridgecold19
As the world continues to spin, a single ant attempts to stop it.
The ant’s name is Yumi Yamaguchi — and she will soon learn just how weak she is even if she can lift things up to fifty times her body weight.
: Oh! Yumi!
scene yumibridgecold20
: Hm?

Another cool ant fact is that the queen of the Pogonomyrmex occidentalis owyheei is the second longest living insect with a lifespan of up to 30 years. This is only 20 years less than the maximum lifespan of a termite queen.
scene yumibridgecold21
: Coming to see your mom? Would you mind giving her this? Mailman left her shit in my box again.
: Why do you know my name?
: Because you’re my new best friend’s daughter, obviously.
: Who even are you?
: Not the mailman, that’s for sure! So please relieve me of needing to hold onto this as I will not be able to resist the temptation of opening it and I can’t handle another felony. I just can’t.
scene black
: Fine, yeah. Give it here. Probably just a bill or something.
: Woo! Thanks. Love you. Tell your mom I said hi.
: Uh...no?
scene yumibridgecold22
Did you know that ants don’t have ears? They listen by feeling vibrations in the ground. And they communicate with other ants by using their body to produce pheromones.
: Yuki! You home? Your fucking weirdo neighbor gave me your mail.
A group of ants is called a “formicary.” They are social creatures who, like bees, distribute and delegate different responsibilities to everyone in the colony.
scene yumibridgecold23
: Let’s see how much you fuckin’ owe. Maybe I can help out now that I’ve actually got a job?
Ants are found on every single continent except for Antarctica. And one species, the trap jaw ant, can close its jaws at a speed of 140mph! How crazy is that?
scene yumibridgecold24
Do you know the craziest part of all, though?
scene yumibridgecold25
We’re just like them when you really start to think about it.
scene black
We’re all so small in the grand scheme of things — running around in circles and trying to fulfill some sort of arbitrary purpose we come up with that won’t ever really matter.
But we’ll tell ourselves it does because we need a meaning to live. We need a meaning to run around in circles from dusk ‘til dawn.
But if you take one ant away, will anyone really notice?
If you’re the queen, sure.
If you’re anyone else, though?
How long will it take the others to even notice you’re even gone?
: Hello?
